name: github_pr
title: GitHub PRs
description: Each open pull request you opened, whose review is requested from you or that mentions you is a conversation; its comments and reviews are the messages.

permission.github.pull_requests.read.why: Reads the pull requests you opened or that await your review, or that mention you, with their comments and reviews.

permission.github.pull_requests.comment.why: Posts your replies as comments on those pull requests.

filter.label: Start a conversation when a PR is
filter.hint: mine (opened by you, awaiting your review or mentioning you — the default), assigned (assigned to you) or review_requested (your review is requested).

repos.label: Repositories
repos.hint: owner/repo per line; empty = every repository you can reach

dependabot.label: Include Dependabot PRs
dependabot.hint: Dependabot's open PRs in these repositories — or, with none listed, in your organisations and your own account.
